why: The answer correctly applies the compile rule to this case: a successful javac Big.java produces Big.class and prints no program output, and the program has not run yet. It gives the result with a reason but does not explain that java Big must load the Big.class that javac made.

concepts.quote: There is a Big.class file now, but nothing is printed because the program has not run yet.
concepts.why: It correctly predicts what javac gives here (Big.class, no output) and does not fall into the misconception that compiling runs the program.

concepts.quote: nothing is printed because the program has not run yet
